{{Quote|Ngani Zho. Greatest warrior of his generation, trained half the Jedi Council&mdash;including Grand Master Satele Shan.|[[Marcus Trant|SIS Director]]|<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />}}
'''Ngani Zho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
===Great Galactic War===
During the [[Great Galactic War]], Jedi Master Zho trained many Jedi, including [[Satele Shan]], a descendant of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Bastila Shan]], and others who would soon join Shan as members of [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]: [[Bela Kiwiiks]], [[Jaric Kaedan]], and [[Syo Bakarn]]. When [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] was taken back by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Zho fought with many Jedi against the Empire. However, as years passed, Zho found himself too old to fight and took the request in training Satele's son, [[Theron Shan]], who turned out not to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] despite Ngani's best efforts.

===Cold War===
After the the Great Galactic War ended, Ngani Zho disappeared during the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3653 BBY]]. [[3643 BBY|Ten years later]], Zho was seen in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] with Republic agent Theron Shan. During a mission on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Zho and Theron were [[Ambush on Taris (Cold War)|ambushed]] by [[Darth Mekhis]] and [[Darth Mekhis' Sith Knights|her Sith Knights]], but they were able to escape. They flew together with [[Teff'ith]] into the system where they discovered the super weapons that the Imperials built. Theron decided to infiltrate the the Imperial base and destroy the weapons, along with Zho and Teff'ith. However, Master Zho was killed in the fight when he engaged many [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]], while attempting to defend Teff'ith.
